title: Reach conditional κ = 0.0038982 with a 29-fold smaller maximum rank exponent
body:
One complete signed multiplier reaches **conditional κ = 0.0038982**, with its largest native rank reduced from **2^20,000,000 to 2^680,000**. Its exact gain over ToikY's 0.0038981730255 is **53949/2000000000000**. The same program selects an early complete native path and pays for that entire interval at the stated final rate. [Complete construction and comparison](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7b48187d99525ad59f560de3921ec7e48382484c/research/tiered-native-multiplier/README.md) · [Independent exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7b48187d99525ad59f560de3921ec7e48382484c/research/tiered-native-multiplier/RESULT.json) · [PR #8054](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8054)

| Whole-machine quantity | K7 with two unsplit returns | This construction |
|---|---:|---:|
| Complete κ | 0.0038981730255 | 0.0038982 |
| Terminal ordinary log₂ ranks | 60,000 and 960,000 | 35,327 and 559,005 |
| Terminal Gaussian log₂ rank | 20,000,000 | 680,000 |
| Sufficient activation exponent A | 21,020,646 | 7,437 for the early complete path, 1,274,851 for terminal ranks |
| Published log₂ fixed setup ceiling | 513 | 228 |
| All-input log₂ recurring coefficient ceiling | 21,111,681,659 | 339,787,971 |

Here the sufficient input length is `2^(ceil(2^A/6)-1)+1` significant bits. The fixed-tape bound for every input of length n ≥ 2 is `2^339787971 n (1+log₂ n)^(1−0.0038982)` individual reads, writes and moves after fixed installation. Applying the revised local clock to the incumbent also improves its ceiling to 4,726,401,730. An earlier one-stage configuration has A = 6,913 at κ = .00363005817. The existing compact two-stage configuration has A = 161,992 at κ = .00387992803556. These are important lower-rate scale comparisons. Even the early tier here needs 2^7412 genuine outer axes. [Complete clock, live stock and both entrances](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7b48187d99525ad59f560de3921ec7e48382484c/research/tiered-native-multiplier/CLOCK.md)

The new paid Gaussian word runs the 48-call source at physical column dilations 1 and 79. It reconstructs and consumes 62 transport cells across 105,216 owners and 564,144 chronological loans. Independent intervals put the 1-to-8 peer's raw ceiling below .003898180942173 even after its two unsplits. A physical replay checks the new source on two nonzero witnesses, including every owner return. The movement analysis counts 189,072 extra full-field phase calls per large copy when its base width times the bundle is 2 modulo 4. The K7 binary word funds both ordinary stages. A separate finite-interval proof charges the early tier 572 extra bits in the recurring coefficient. [Numerical proof and movement](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7b48187d99525ad59f560de3921ec7e48382484c/research/tiered-native-multiplier/NUMERICAL.md) · [Source patches and hashes](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7b48187d99525ad59f560de3921ec7e48382484c/research/tiered-native-multiplier/SOURCES.json)

Quadratic phase compilation and shared chronological roles reduce actual preparation. The installer can build both profiles without enumerating 669,360 Gaussian grade entries during fixed setup. Active calendar generation still pays to emit them. Matched fresh-process installations took 94.90 seconds for the new two-return peer and 5.06 seconds for this machine. The preceding fixed-carrier peer and this machine averaged 82.62 and 5.09 seconds in two runs per version. The last 13 bits of improvement from the predecessor installer’s 2^241 upper bound come from serial arithmetic and a sharper accounting. The observations measure fixed setup on one machine. [Setup proof and measurements](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7b48187d99525ad59f560de3921ec7e48382484c/research/tiered-native-multiplier/SETUP.md) · [Serial arithmetic](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7b48187d99525ad59f560de3921ec7e48382484c/research/tiered-native-multiplier/SERIAL-SETUP.md)

The signed Fourier control returns −345550037539 from the five expected coefficients with 138 physical shuttles and 157,248 H calls. Production-size execution, a speed crossover and independent scientific acceptance remain open. The inherited premises are all-column native action, owned erasure, uniform compiler closure, fixed-tape precision and movement, and analytic recovery. Lean 4.34.1 and leanchecker verify the physical placement fences and the finite-prefix conversion. The complete scientific theorem and tape trace remain conditional written arguments. [Verification and trust boundary](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7b48187d99525ad59f560de3921ec7e48382484c/research/tiered-native-multiplier/VERIFICATION.md) · [Kernel-checked clock statements](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7b48187d99525ad59f560de3921ec7e48382484c/research/tiered-native-multiplier/TierCost.lean)
